summary: Official Pear VC pages show PearX S26 applications are active on a rolling basis after the April 12 regular deadline, with the cohort kicking off in July 2026. Exact start, end, and demo day dates are not published.

proposed_event.name: PearX S26
proposed_event.description: 12-week in-person pre-seed accelerator from Pear VC with investment, mentorship, credits, and Demo Day.

dates.date_range_text: S26 regular application deadline was April 12; applications submitted after are reviewed on a rolling basis. Cohort kicks off July 2026 and runs 12 weeks.

sources.title: PearX Application - Pear VC
sources.supports: Official application page states PearX S26 applications, regular deadline April 12, post-deadline rolling review; page metadata states applications are open and the program kicks off July 2026.

sources.title: PearX - Pear VC
sources.supports: Official program page states PearX is a 12-week pre-seed accelerator, invests $250K-$2M, offers mentorship, cloud/provider credits, Demo Day, annual Summer/Winter cadence, and requires companies to relocate to the SF Bay Area for the program.

notes: Exact S26 program start date, program end date, and Demo Day date were not published on the official pages reviewed.

The application page gives April 12 without an explicit year in visible body text; because the page is titled S26 and official metadata says the cohort kicks off July 2026, this record treats it as the S26 regular deadline but leaves application_close null because rolling review remains available.
